plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for TERRA sti440 headend receivers (enterprise PEN 30631, TERRA-sti440-MIB). Besides standard IF-MIB interface traffic and uptime, it reports CPU load, internal temperature, supply voltage and per-tuner input level and SNR.
name: Transmission

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU load of the TERRA sti440 headend receiver as a 0-100 percentage (TERRA-sti440-MIB cpuLoad scalar).

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Internal temperature of the TERRA sti440 headend receiver in degrees Celsius (TERRA-sti440-MIB intTemp scalar).

metrics.name: terra_supply_voltage_volts
metrics.description: Supply voltage of the TERRA sti440 headend receiver in volts (TERRA-sti440-MIB volt scalar, Integer32 in tenths of a volt, divided by 10 in the collector).

metrics.name: terra_tuner_level_dbuv
metrics.description: RF input level of each TERRA sti440 tuner in dBuV (TERRA-sti440-MIB inlevel1..4 scalars).

metrics.name: terra_tuner_snr_db
metrics.description: Input signal-to-noise ratio of each TERRA sti440 tuner in dB (TERRA-sti440-MIB insnr1..4 scalars).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
